annotation.title_clean: AIの利用・開発に関する契約チェックリスト
annotation.title_en: Contract Checklist for the Use and Development of AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 経済産業省 (Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, Japan)
named_instruments_referenced: AI・データの利用に関する契約ガイドライン
Japan Act on the Protection of Personal Information
annotation.summary_en: METI's February 2025 checklist helps Japanese businesses, including legal novices, review contracts for using or developing AI services. It covers handling of inputs and outputs (provision, use, onward provision, ownership), plus personal data law, security, training-use of data, and terms-of-service changes. Software-focused with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines three contract types: general AI service use, customization, and new development.
Checks input/output specification, provision, use, external provision and rights attribution clauses.
Flags cautions on inputs used for AI training and IP transfer without compensation.
Explains Personal Information Protection Act Articles 27–28 for domestic and cross-border data provision.
Recommends security level, audit clauses, log retention and monitoring of terms-of-service changes.
